title: AliQwen Office Launches the Agent Suite: From Automated Scripts to Digital Employees with Identity and Responsibility
excerpt: On September 22, 2026, at the 2026 Cloud Computing Conference, QwenWork released a series of products and capability upgrades centered around enterprise-level A
content_html:
On September 22, 2026, at the 2026 Cloud Computing Conference, QwenWork released a series of products and capability upgrades centered around enterprise-level Agents, with the theme "making enterprise-level Agents understand business, collaborate effectively, and be trustworthy."

For enterprise data understanding, QwenWork launched "Enterprise Context," which compresses and structures information scattered across documents, communications, and business systems, updating with business changes. This allows Agents to make judgments based on the latest real-time business conditions. With an internal dedicated model, it processes information at a very low Token cost. Based on QwenWork and DingTalk, enterprises can create "digital employees" with organizational attributes — having names, departments, supervisors, responsibilities, and authorization boundaries. All execution records are traceable, achieving "entering the organization, defining business, and taking responsibility."

In terms of collaboration, enterprises can create collaborative spaces, link group chats, documents, and knowledge bases, and add members and digital employees. Employees and Agents, as well as between Agents, can work together in the same space, producing unified results that are accumulated; the "App" feature allows enterprises and SaaS vendors to integrate business systems as apps, preserving the original interface and data while adding Agent capabilities, with results able to be written back into the business system. In hardware, QwenWork launched its first Agent device, QwenNote, with the first product A2 supporting voice-to-text recording and voice-activated task execution. The transcribed content is only kept as text and summaries, without retaining original audio to protect privacy.
